title: SLP 8-Region Pressure-Only Ground Truth Contract v1.1
description: Machine contract for the SLP_8Region_Pressure_VAL_v1.1 dataset (4,590 samples, 102 danaLab subjects, uncover only). Default training labels are the 8 semantic regions exported from V221_CORRECTED_SUPPORT. NOT human pixel-level semantic masks; provenance is V221_CORRECTED_SUPPORT_AUTO_ACCEPTED. NOT medical, skin-interface stress, or product ground truth.

split.description: VAL = accepted standard-answer pool (project reference GT). B01 training uses VAL as its subject pool; train/val/test subject assignment is derived via the frozen A06 split. VAL is not an ML-style train/val/test split; it is the approved canonical reference.

setting.description: Only danaLab is in this dataset; simLab is not included.

cover.description: Only uncover condition is present; cover1/cover2 are not in this dataset.

frame_id.description: SLP frame index within a session (1-45).

posture.description: Body orientation. LEFT = left-side down; RIGHT = right-side down.

pressure_npy.description: Relative path from dataset root to pressure.npy (must stay within dataset root).

region_onehot_npy.description: Relative path to region_onehot.npy. Required — all 4,590 samples include it; adapter enforces non-null.

points_csv.description: Relative path to points.csv (redundant compatibility format; optional).

class_ids_present.description: Set of class IDs present in this sample (0..8). Always includes 0 (BACKGROUND). May miss some body regions.

annotation_provenance.description: Source of region labels: V221_CORRECTED_SUPPORT_SEMANTIC_PNG generated by V221 pipeline, auto-accepted without per-frame human review. NOT human-annotated pixel-level masks.

source_status.description: Original source quality status from production pipeline.

source_flags.description: Quality flags from production: ARM_TORSO_OCCLUSION, JOINT_OCCLUDED, etc.

source_review_status.description: Per-frame human review status: NOT_REVIEWED. This is an automated pipeline export.

clipped_ratio.description: Fraction of body-pixel area (source PMarray) that mapped outside the 192x84 Pressure sensor frame. Values near 1.0 indicate the subject's body extends beyond the pressure mat boundary. Not a quality gate; use as contextual metadata.

source_pmarray_sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the original PMarray source file (before pressure normalization). Used for data integrity verification.

body_pixel_count.description: Pixel count of all body regions combined.
